ledger.claim: Within 40 seconds of the driver's arrival marker the rider sent a locating message in the app — 'im at the pickup, cant see you', sent 19:37:18 and delivered 19:37:19 — and the driver posted no reply in the chat log within the following 120 seconds and logged no in-app voice call at any point before cancelling at 19:44:30 (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty). Limbs (a) and (b) of POL-NS-04 are therefore satisfied on this record. Limb (c) alone cannot be completed, because EV-GPS-02734 carries no rider track at all (derived.rider_presence.available is false and rider_fix_count is 0). Under POL-NS-11 limb (c) is undecidable — neither satisfied nor failed — and the Judge must record the test as one that could not be run rather than inferring that the rider was elsewhere. The rider's account of the failed handover is thus unrebutted, even though POL-NS-11 stops this clause from exonerating the rider by itself.

The absent rider track is a gap in the platform's own export, not evidence about the rider: derived.rider_presence reports available false, fix_count 0 and rider_qualifying_fix_count 0. POL-NS-11 makes that absence neutral — it is not the evidence for any deciding fact of the no-show clauses, it does not impair the driver's track for arrival or dwell, and it does not lower the POL-GEN-02(2) confidence cap on a finding drawn from the driver's own track. The only location statement on the record is the rider's own contemporaneous in-app message placing them at the pickup, and the counterparty statement ('Waited the full period.') does not contradict it.

This dispute is rider-filed and the rider is the party presently carrying the money: EV-FARE-02734 shows total_charged 4.50, all of it the cancellation-fee line, with base, distance, time, platform, promo and waiting-time lines all 0.00, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. Read off the record under POL-GEN-03, a disposition that leaves the present state as it stands leaves this rider paying SGD 4.50 for a trip the driver terminated with no boarding event and no completed trip; only a refund to the filing party takes that charge off the rider.

The only traffic advisory for this pickup, EV-ADVIS-02734-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT: no advisory covers Blk 412 Pasir Ris Dr 6 in this window, as the trace's own accumulated-dwell limb analysis records. I cite the absence and nothing more — it carries no fact for either party. Its effect is that POL-NS-06(i) cannot be run here, because that limb requires an advisory that is present and populated, so nothing on this record permits the required waiting period to be extended or separate in-geofence intervals to be summed. The period that had to be served is therefore the 180 s free waiting period in force under trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, read as POL-NS-01(c) directs.

The rider does not contest, because this record does not permit it, the arithmetic of the driver's own track: the longest qualifying in-geofence run is 469 s, running from the first qualifying fix at 19:36:38 to 19:44:27, against a minimum of the 180 s free waiting period in force, and the driver's arrival marker falls at the start of that same run. The rider cannot break POL-NS-01 limbs (b) or (c), or the POL-NS-02 proximity test, on this evidence, and the rider's case accordingly rests on POL-NS-04 and POL-NS-11 alone.

All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold on this record. (a) The trip record carries a driver arrival event for this trip, 'I'm Here' tapped at 19:36:38 (EV-TRIP-02734). (b) The exported trace places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at that same second: derived.arrival.arrived_at is 19:36:38, the first qualifying in-geofence fix is timestamped 19:36:38, and 48 qualifying fixes sit inside the radius (EV-GPS-02734) — the consecutive-fix proximity test of POL-NS-02 is met many times over, with 100% coverage, a 10 s cadence and no gaps anywhere in the trace. (c) The driver then held position inside that geofence for a continuous 469 seconds, from the first qualifying fix at 19:36:38 to 19:44:27, against the free waiting period of 180 seconds in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180), with platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec unset so no longer threshold applies. (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 19:44:30 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the required dwell had elapsed, and the record shows no boarding event. The cancellation fee is therefore legitimately chargeable.

The rider's only arithmetic route to a refund is the waiting-period shortfall in POL-NS-06, and there is no shortfall to find. Measured in-geofence dwell is 469 seconds against the 180 second minimum in force; the derived shortfall is minus 289 seconds, i.e. a surplus of 289 seconds beyond the minimum. That surplus is robust to which figure is used: 469 s also clears the 300 s legacy STANDARD entry retained in the schedule for pre-version-2 records. The clock runs from the first qualifying in-geofence fix under POL-NS-01(c), not from the driver's tap, and here the two coincide to the second (both 19:36:38), so no POL-NS-05 correction moves the start.

The false-arrival clause does not bite. The marker here is a BUTTON press at 19:36:38, and at that moment the trace places the driver at the pickup, not on an expressway: the trace's closest approach to the pin is 0.157 m and the first qualifying in-geofence fix is at the same second as the marker, so the driver was neither more than 300 m from the pin nor moving at 15 km/h or above when he tapped. The 48 qualifying fixes that follow sit inside the 50 m radius for 469 seconds, which is inconsistent with a driver who tapped early and drove on. Nor is there any clock skew: trip_record.arrived_at and the nearest qualifying fix are the same second, far inside the 90 second threshold of POL-NS-08(a).

The rider's messaging point cannot exonerate her. Limbs (a) and (b) of POL-NS-04 may well hold — she sent one locating message at 19:37:18 and the driver posted no chat reply and made no in-app call — but limb (c) requires the rider's own device track to place her within 100 m of the pin for the majority of qualifying fixes across the waiting window, and EV-GPS-02734 carries no rider track at all (derived.rider_presence.available is false, fix_count 0). Under POL-NS-11 that makes limb (c) UNDECIDABLE rather than satisfied: POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, the missing rider track is not the evidence for any deciding fact of POL-NS-01, and the fee is decided on the driver's own evidence, which is complete.

The wrong-entrance route in POL-NS-03 is not engaged either. POL-NS-03 governs only where the driver's stationary fixes lie outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin; here the driver's sustained stationary run is inside the 50 m radius, so POL-NS-02 is satisfied rather than yielded. Consistently with that, the record carries a single registered pickup point at a signed venue (VEN-PASIR-RIS-DR6), so there is no pin ambiguity and no platform-funded goodwill payment to consider.

No traffic advisory covers the pickup road in this window: EV-ADVIS-02734-01 is MISSING, has no payload, carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and fired issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — I disclose that impairment on the face of this claim. On the policy's own terms the absence ends limb (i) of POL-NS-06, which requires an advisory that is present and populated; and in any event limb (i) only ever permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed, it never reduces the required minimum and never excuses a shortfall. There is one continuous in-geofence interval here (run_count 1) and nothing to sum.

Because POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the cancellation fee in force: 80 percent of SGD 4.50 is SGD 3.60, which is the figure the fare evidence itself derives (EV-FARE-02734 driver_compensation = 3.60). The anti-farming check does not trip and it requires both limbs: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the 4 required, and 2 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 92 is 0.022, below the 0.08 required. Compensation is therefore payable, and per POL-GEN-03 the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd mirroring the driver compensation, the charge to the rider standing meanwhile.

The money reconciles, so there is no ledger integrity defect for the rider to exploit under POL-NS-08(d): fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee is 4.50 and the platform_policy in force for this trip states cancellation_fee_sgd 4.50 (the net figure under resolution_rule), payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00. On this rider-filed dispute the present state stands — nothing is owed back to her — while the case nonetheless produces a payment to the driver, so the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and not NO_ACTION.

No POL-NS-09 trigger is present and the case is decidable now. The GPS artifact is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 — 104 fixes, 100% coverage, max_gap_sec 0.0, no sampling gap inside the waiting window — so the deciding facts are not carried by evidence impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d) and the confidence cap is not engaged. rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so the repeat-dispute limb fails; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is untripped, so the abuse limb fails; and no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival or dwell, the trip record's arrival event and the trace agreeing to the second.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 charged to the rider stands, and the driver is paid SGD 3.60 in compensation, being 80 percent of that fee, with the remaining 20 percent retained as the platform's service fee. The ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION because that is the outcome the case produces; the rider's own charge is not refunded, so the filing party's claim is not supported.

Why the fee stands. Every limb of POL-NS-01 holds on this record. (a) The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event, tapped at 19:36:38 (EV-TRIP-02734). (b) The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02734) places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at that same second: arrived_at is 19:36:38, the first qualifying in-geofence fix is 19:36:38, and 48 qualifying fixes sit inside the radius, so the POL-NS-02 proximity test is met with room to spare. (c) The driver then held position continuously for 469 seconds, from 19:36:38 to 19:44:27, against the free waiting period of 180 seconds in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180; no_show_threshold_sec is unset, so no longer threshold applies). (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 19:44:30 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the required dwell had elapsed, with no boarding event. The fee is therefore legitimately chargeable.

Rider's claims, answered. (1) The rider's POL-NS-04 / POL-NS-11 claim is correctly stated but does not win the case. The locating message 'im at the pickup, cant see you' was sent at 19:37:18 and the driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor logged an in-app call before cancelling, so limbs (a) and (b) of POL-NS-04 hold. Limb (c), however, cannot be run: EV-GPS-02734 carries no rider track at all (rider_fix_count 0). Under POL-NS-11 that makes limb (c) UNDECIDABLE — neither satisfied nor failed — so POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider. I record that the test could not be run, and I do not infer that the rider was elsewhere. The absent rider track is a gap in the platform's export; it does not impair the driver's trace for arrival or dwell and does not lower the confidence cap on a finding drawn from the driver's own track. (2) The rider's POL-GEN-03 argument — that a disposition leaving the present state stands leaves the rider paying SGD 4.50 for a trip that produced no boarding and no completed trip, so only a refund takes the charge off her — is rejected. Since POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, the fee is properly chargeable; the disposition of the fee is that it stands, and the payment this case produces is to the driver, which is what makes the emitted value DRIVER_COMPENSATION rather than NO_ACTION. (3) The rider does not contest, and the record does not permit contesting, the arrival and dwell arithmetic; that concession is accepted. (4) The rider's POL-NS-06 claim about the missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02734-01, weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT, impairment disclosed) is accepted as far as it goes: POL-NS-06(i) cannot run because it requires an advisory that is present and populated, and in any event there is one continuous in-geofence interval (run_count 1) with nothing to sum and no shortfall — dwell of 469 seconds against a 180 second minimum is a surplus of 289 seconds, not a deficit.

Driver's claims, answered. (1) The POL-NS-01 / POL-NS-02 claim is accepted (above). (2) The POL-NS-06 claim is accepted: the derived shortfall is minus 289 seconds, i.e. no shortfall, and the clock runs from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, which coincides with the arrival marker to the second, so no POL-NS-05 correction moves the start. (3) The POL-NS-05 false-arrival claim is accepted: the marker was a BUTTON press at 19:36:38 at which the trace places the driver at the pickup (closest approach 0.157 m), not more than 300 m away and not moving at 15 km/h or above; no clock skew exceeds the 90 second threshold of POL-NS-08(a). No false-arrival referral arises, because the clause does not bite. (4) The POL-NS-03 claim is accepted: the driver's sustained stationary run is inside the 50 m radius, so POL-NS-02 is satisfied rather than yielded, and there is a single registered pickup point, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. (5) The POL-NS-07 claim is accepted: POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so compensation is 80 percent of SGD 4.50 = SGD 3.60, the figure EV-FARE-02734 itself derives. The anti-farming check requires both limbs and trips neither: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2 (below 4) and 2 divided by completed_trips_30d of 92 is about 0.022 (below 0.08). Only the fields POL-GEN-01 permits for this test were used. (6) The POL-NS-08(d) money-reconciliation claim is accepted: fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee of 4.50 equals the net figure of 4.50 read from the platform policy in force (resolution_rule), payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00, so there is no ledger integrity defect. (7) The POL-NS-09 / POL-GEN-02 claim is accepted: no escalation trigger fires. The GPS artifact is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 — 104 fixes, 100 percent coverage, max gap 0.0 s — so no deciding fact rests on evidence impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d); the counterparty dispute counters are both 0; no_show_disputes_30d is 0; the anti-farming check is untripped; and no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival or dwell.

No clause produces a referral here: POL-NS-05 does not fire, POL-NS-06 does not fire with a shortfall, and the reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW was correctly selected, so no driver-education item is recorded. No open question is referred; none is needed. The monetary effect is SGD 3.60, below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so the ruling executes automatically on issue subject to appeal under POL-GEN-04. Confidence is 0.95, sitting under the cap of 1.0 set by the weight-1.0 artifacts that carry the deciding facts.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
